sourceText:
Eggplant Pizza
By: Amy Jeanroy
Published: Sunday, July 17, 2011 - 8:12pm

Ingredients




2 inches medium eggplant, sliced into 1/2 slices
1/2 cup olive oil
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 cloves minced garlic
2 cups pizza sauce
1 cup shredded mozzarella

Preparation

1 On a cookie sheet, place the slices of eggplant. 2 Brush olive oil onto each slice and grill for 3 minutes on each side to give them good grill marks and flavor. 3 In a saucepan, heat 1 Tbsp olive oil and saute onion and garlic until translucent 4 Add pizza sauce to saucepan and bring to a boil. 5 Remove from  heat and spread hot sauce on each eggplant slice. 6 Sprinkle with cheese and heat on  medium heat on grill for 3 - 5 minutes or until cheese is melted and hot.

About


Add your favorite pizza toppings to cheese before the final grilling step.
